title: Emergency Department Triage and Bed Allocation

steps.description: Receive patient at triage counter, record vital signs, and assign Emergency Severity Index (ESI Level 1-5).
Generate unique UHID if new patient or retrieve existing medical history via UHID search.
Assign patient to acute resuscitation bay or emergency observation bed (BED-ER-01 to BED-ER-10).
Emergency physician performs primary trauma/medical assessment and enters initial diagnostic orders.
Determine inpatient admission necessity and notify admitting coordinator for bed blocking.

common_blockers: No available resuscitation beds during multi-casualty incidents
Missing guardian or patient identification for unconscious road traffic accident victims
Delay in CT Brain imaging authorization for trauma cases
